conclusion.evidence: Pushforward proof above converts the history-law lintegral to the frozen P-space integral, with stopped weight0. Joint measurability and boundedness are required internally available source ingredients, not added assumptions.

deltas.description: History-law nonnegative lintegral is exactly the frozen P-space live-guarded integral after measurable history pushforward; it adds no hypothesis.
Measurable d and MeasurableSet A are explicit admissible-test restrictions, not new PBPS analytic assumptions or providers. The authors did not print a free duration-function binder.
Joint history/raw-tail event measurability, weight measurability and pointwise weight<=1 are derived conclusions consistent with source hazard regularity and nonnegative intensity.
False stopped survival and zero stopped weight match the live guard; live current records with infinite next waits are not discarded.
Only prospective S87-I4 is targeted; I5/fullA7/final-factor assembly/random-time restart/Markov/invariance/cost/main/Goal remain open.

admissible_test_class_audit.duration: d is an arbitrary deterministic function on the complete finite tagged-history Borel carrier with values in finite NNReal. Measurable d is explicitly a restriction to the admissible Borel test-function class. It is not a seventh analytic assumption on V/process/clock law, and not a measurability certificate for the actual history or random hazard.
admissible_test_class_audit.duration_source_delta: The authors do not print this free d binder. It is an explicit source-implicit interface generalization justified by measurable-parameter exponential integration and needed for the random remaining-horizon consumer.
admissible_test_class_audit.events: A ranges over every measurable history event, including null events. MeasurableSet A defines admissible event tests; no P(A)>0 restriction or conditional-probability division is added.
admissible_test_class_audit.source_binder_discipline: Retain an explicit source-implicit/generalization ledger for these test-class quantifiers. Do not label Measurable d a printed paper-wide hypothesis or pure carrier-only typing, and do not hide it inside an unexplained provider bundle.
admissible_test_class_audit.no_tail_inspection: d receives only a finite history argument. Since actual H_n is a consumed-prefix function, d(H_n) cannot inspect unused raw clocks. No additional causality assumption on d is needed.
admissible_test_class_audit.required_consumer: For each fixed T>=0, define d_T(h) by matching the last record: live(t,z) maps to Real.toNNReal(T-t), stopped maps to0. This is Borel by finite evaluation, sum cases, time projection and continuous clipping. Universal d already includes it; no second fixed-u SAU is needed.

pushforward_equivalence.notation: Let H=history(y,xRef,z0,n), mu=Measure.map H P, and W(h)=survivalWeight(y,xRef,h_n,d(h)).
pushforward_equivalence.header_RHS: Integral over h in A of W(h) against mu.
pushforward_equivalence.frozen_RHS: Integral over H^-1(A) intersect L_n of ENNReal.ofReal(exp(-Lambda_(Z_n)(d(H(w))))) against P.
equivalence_route: Derive actual H measurability from the unchanged accepted finite-history producer.
The header itself requires W measurability as a conclusion, derived from literal hazard/record and Measurable d.
For measurable A, nonnegative measurable pushforward integration gives integral_A W d(H_*P)=integral_(H^-1(A)) W(H(w)) dP.
On a live last record W(H(w)) is the exponential hazard factor; on a stopped record it is0. Thus the integral equals the frozen live-restricted P-space formula exactly.
The last record in H is definitionally record_n, so the two left survival events also agree exactly.
pushforward_equivalence.null_event: When mu(A)=P(H^-1(A))=0, the restricted lintegral and the live-guarded event probability both vanish.
pushforward_equivalence.probability_carriers: Header event measurability is on History_n times the entire unused raw-tail space. Its clock p.2(0) corresponds under the joint history/tail pushforward to raw w(n), source E_(n+1).

endpoints_and_tagged_branch_audit.source_crossing: tau is first >=-hazard crossing, with empty crossing set infinity; liveSurvival is strict u<tau. Source continuity/monotonicity must prove equivalence to e>Lambda(u) internally.
endpoints_and_tagged_branch_audit.zero_duration: At u=0 positive source clocks give survival1 on live records; zero raw clocks belong to the null ambient extension and have tau(0)=0.
endpoints_and_tagged_branch_audit.zero_rate: An initially live zero-rate record has infinite next wait for positive clocks, hence survival1 for finite u. After a prior stopped tag no next wait is asserted and both event/weight contributions are0.
endpoints_and_tagged_branch_audit.zero_normal: Total reflection formula remains R0=I; no nonzero-normal assumption.
endpoints_and_tagged_branch_audit.infinite_wait: A live current record with next tau=infinity belongs to survival for every finite d. d itself is finite NNReal-valued, so the header does not assert an infinite-duration limit or an infinite-wait mass theorem.
endpoints_and_tagged_branch_audit.unbounded_d: d can be unbounded across histories; every realized duration is finite, each deterministic arc hazard is finite, and the survival weight remains<=1.
endpoints_and_tagged_branch_audit.final_horizon: d_T=(T-T_n)_+ is allowed, while the source final-factor consumer must still impose its correct live-before-T history event, endpoint convention and ordered-time integration in I5.
